title: Application menus
text: A horizontal bar of commands and menus with submenus, checkboxes, and radio groups.

title: Full keyboard support
text: Arrow keys move between menus while one is open, and typeahead jumps to items.

title: One select event
text: Every chosen command arrives as a single event on the host, wherever it sits.

title: Custom rendering
text: Render items yourself while the bar keeps roles, focus, and keyboard handling.
